en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional-sounding love song, origin unclear. 'Да се ситат' (line 'for enemies to feast') and 'да испукаат' (burst with envy) are my reading.

lines.cyr: да ти видам бело лице, црни очи,
lines.lat: da ti vidam belo lice, crni oči,
lines.en: so I can see your white face, black eyes,

lines.cyr: оти време е да бегам да далеку.
lines.lat: oti vreme e da begam da daleku.
lines.en: for it is time for me to flee far away.

lines.cyr: - А бре лудо, ти бре младо,
lines.lat: - A bre ludo, ti bre mlado,

lines.en: where will you go, oh dear,

lines.cyr: кому мене ќе оставиш, млада дадена,
lines.lat: komu mene ḱe ostaviš, mlada dadena,
lines.en: whom will you leave me to, a bride promised to you,

lines.cyr: душманите да се ситат, јас да тагувам?
lines.lat: dušmanite da se sitat, jas da taguvam?
lines.en: for enemies to feast, for me to grieve?

lines.cyr: пари да спечалам, либе, свадба да правам,
lines.lat: pari da spečalam, libe, svadba da pravam,
lines.en: to earn money, love, to hold a wedding,

lines.cyr: тебе да те земам, душо, за невеста.
lines.lat: tebe da te zemam, dušo, za nevesta.
lines.en: to take you, my soul, as my bride.
let me embrace you, oh dear,

lines.cyr: за да знае цело маало колку те сакам,
lines.lat: za da znae celo maalo kolku te sakam,
lines.en: so the whole neighbourhood knows how much I love you,
let the enemies, men and women, burst with envy.
